Specification: This specification models Euclid's algorithm, starting from a fixed value 24 and a second value chosen from the range 1..N, to compute their greatest common divisor by repeated subtraction and swapping. The file contains a PlusCal algorithm and its generated TLA+ translation, with control-state variable pc and state variables u, v, and v_ini. The temporal specification requires initialization, repeated Next steps with stuttering allowed, and weak fairness of Next; it also defines a termination property asserting that the control eventually reaches the "Done" state.
IfThenElse: IF u # 0 THEN /\ IF u < v THEN /\ /\ u' = v /\ v' = u ELSE /\ TRUE /\ UNCHANGED << u, v >> /\ pc' = "a" ELSE /\ PrintT(<<v, "= GCD of 24 and ", v_ini>>) /\ pc' = "Done" /\ UNCHANGED << u, v >>
IF u < v THEN /\ /\ u' = v /\ v' = u ELSE /\ TRUE /\ UNCHANGED << u, v >>
ChoiceExpr:
CHOOSE i \in (1..x) \cap (1..y) :
                /\ x % i = 0 
                /\ y % i = 0
                /\ \A j \in (1..x) \cap (1..y) :
                        /\ x % j = 0 
                        /\ y % j = 0
                        => i \geq j
